name: agent-recorded-question-not-added-again
about: A question the agent recorded with its record tool is in <open>, so the reply that asks the same thing adds nothing.

items.ask: Edit the shared onboarding page's SSO section?

exchange.person: the onboarding page is wrong about SSO, look into it
exchange.reply:
The onboarding page says SSO is set up per user. It is set up per workspace: an admin turns it on once in Settings → Security, and every member then signs in with it.

The page is shared with the support team, so I won't edit the page without your OK. The change replaces the second paragraph of the SSO section with the per-workspace steps. I'd approve it.

name: agent-recorded-question-other-ask-added

items.ask: Which region should the exports bucket live in?

exchange.person: set up the storage bucket for the exports
exchange.reply: I wrote the Terraform for the exports bucket in infra/exports.tf. Before I apply it I need one call from you: host it in US East, next to the API, or in Ireland, next to most of the customers who download exports? I'd go with Ireland: about 70% of export downloads come from Europe.
